summary: The ordered task steps the relation binds. Required.
range: Required array of { type, id } objects. Step type: start | end | job | pickup | delivery (id required except start/end).
constraints: Each step needs a type; id required except for start/end.
businessRules: steps defines: The steps property specifies the tasks or steps that are part of the relation and must be carried out in a manner defined in the type parameter. Please note you can add any number of steps here, ex…
Each element in steps must be valid and consistent with related fields.
Must stay consistent with: relations.steps.type. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
testingGuidance: Negative: a job step missing id -> 400.
